permissions.tagline: Off-grid messaging over Bluetooth and the internet.
permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: Grant these before continuing. Nothing works without them, and asking now means no surprise prompts later.
permissions.privacy: Your data stays on your device. These permissions are only used for local messaging and connectivity.
permissions.bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
permissions.bluetooth.desc: Discover nearby devices and exchange messages over the mesh
permissions.nearby_wifi.title: Nearby WiFi devices
permissions.nearby_wifi.desc: Move large files between nearby devices over a direct WiFi link (much faster than Bluetooth)
permissions.notifications.title: Notifications
permissions.notifications.desc: Alert you when a message arrives while the app is in the background
permissions.storage.title: Storage
permissions.storage.desc: Keep an encrypted backup of your identity so it survives a reinstall, and share files
permissions.storage_legacy.title: Storage
permissions.storage_legacy.desc: Keep an encrypted backup of your identity so it survives a reinstall, and share files
permissions.location.title: Location
permissions.location.desc: Required by Android to find nearby devices over Bluetooth — with location switched off the system returns no scan results at all, so the app goes silently deaf. Also puts your position on the map.
permissions.battery.title: Run in the background
permissions.battery.desc: Let the app keep receiving messages when the screen is off — Android otherwise puts it to sleep
permissions.internet.title: Internet
permissions.internet.desc: Connect to the internet relays and the wapp store (automatic)
